verdict.rationale: An isolated test environment is a fair question for an operating system, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the pack documents a macOS sandbox or test environment that keeps production data untouched. "Run Windows on your Mac" is an adjacent capability, not documented sandbox isolation. Shortcuts automation and Siri actions likewise say nothing about isolated testing or dry-run modes.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
